new_technical_difference: Qwen3 30B-A3B was not in previous shortlist. Resolve original/July Instruct/Thinking version ambiguity; conditional GQA cache estimate from exact public config and critical comparison of non-homogeneous vendor benchmarks. No repeated runtime or prior audit.
position_provenance: ChatGPT position is supplied by user attachment, not a new model call or independent measurement. Codex critically reviews its prior recommendation.

evidence_classes.MISURATO: No CPX52 model RAM, throughput or quality measurement is available for either candidate.
evidence_classes.DOCUMENTATO: Official published properties/declared vendor scores, or historical project evidence; not remeasured.
evidence_classes.STIMATO: Explicit conditional memory arithmetic and feasibility judgments, not measured process memory.

kv_conditional_estimate.formula: 2 (K,V) * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * context * bytes_per_element * sequences
kv_conditional_estimate.assumptions: Fully allocated F16 K/V, all layers; excludes allocator padding, buffers, weights, runtime, services, OS. Installed cache format/config not observed.

vendor_benchmarks.warning: Different publishers, modes and execution protocols; do not infer ranking from same benchmark name or compare AIME 2025 to 2026.
